findings.title: Service Bound to All Interfaces (0.0.0.0:8080)
findings.details: Port 8080 (python3 (PID 1441)) accepts connections from all local network interfaces (0.0.0.0) instead of binding to loopback (127.0.0.1) or routing through Cloudflare Zero Trust.
findings.remediation: Bind service to 127.0.0.1 and tunnel externally via Cloudflare Tunnel.

findings.title: Missing Pre-Push Secret Hook: MicroCorp AI Autonomous Enterprise
findings.details: Repository MicroCorp AI Autonomous Enterprise lacks an active pre-push secret blocking hook. Pushes to public GitHub can accidentally leak credentials.
findings.remediation: Install executable .git/hooks/pre-push script to intercept secret leaks prior to git push.
